subject: MSA & Order Form: review of SLA/support redlines and coordination
messages:
From: Novatek Procurement <procurement@novatek.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@novatek.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form - proposed SLA redlines

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached are Novatek's redlines to the MSA and a marked-up Order Form focused on the SLA and support sections (uptime commitments, response time tiers, and maintenance windows). A few items we'd like to resolve before we proceed to signature: 

- Uptime target: Novatek is seeking a 99.95% monthly availability objective for production endpoints; please confirm whether Redwood can commit or provide a compensated credit schedule.
- Response SLAs: We proposed P1 = 30 min response, P2 = 4 hours; need confirmation on escalation path and on-call contact.
- Maintenance windows: request that planned maintenance be limited to two 4-hour windows per month with 72-hour notice for anything outside the windows.

Can your legal/ops teams review and propose alternatives? We'd like to get this wrapped up within two weeks to hit our internal go-live target.

Attachments: Novatek_MSA_redlines.pdf (PDF, 120 KB), OrderForm-SLA-proposed.docx (DOCX, 45 KB)

Regards,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Cloud Operations
Novatek Systems

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Novatek Procurement <procurement@novatek.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form - proposed SLA redlines

Thanks Carlos — appreciate the clear redlines and the timeline. Looping in Evelyn (legal) and Jordan (sales ops) to triage. High level responses below and attachments with our initial counter-proposals:

- Uptime: 99.95% monthly is aggressive for general-purpose inference at scale; we can offer 99.9% as our standard with an alternative structured credit table that scales toward net-net parity of economics for high-consumption endpoints. See attached OrderForm-SLAs_annotated.docx for the credit matrix we propose.
- Response SLAs: We can commit to a P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes (automated triage + human on-call) and initial response for mitigation within 60 minutes for critical incidents. For P2 we typically target 4 hours. We'll include the escalation ladder in the support section.
- Maintenance windows: We can honor two planned maintenance windows per month of up to 4 hours, with 72 hours notice for standard windows. For emergency maintenance or security patches we reserve the right to act sooner but will provide notification as quickly as possible; we propose an exception carve-out in the MSA to reflect this.

Next steps: Evelyn, can you review Novatek's marked MSA and produce a tracked redline that incorporates the emergency-maintenance carve-out language and the proposed credit table? Jordan, can you confirm whether Novatek's proposed 99.95% is a hard requirement for billing or a negotiation point tied to committed capacity?

I'll propose a joint 30-minute review tomorrow if that works for everyone.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (PDF, 245 KB), OrderForm-SLAs_annotated.docx (DOCX, 60 KB)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Novatek Procurement <procurement@novatek.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@novatek.com>
Date: Fri, 18 May 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form - proposed SLA redlines

Sean / team — I reviewed Novatek's MSA redlines and Sean's attachments. I made attorney comments in the attached PDF and also included tracked language for three key clauses. Summary of changes and rationale below.

1) Availability metric and credit structure
- We should avoid committing to 99.95% across all hosted inference tiers. Operationally and for multi-tenant hosted capacity, 99.9% is reasonable and matches our current SRE profiles.
- Proposed compromise: 99.9% standard; provide an optional "Premium Availability" addendum (Order Form) at 99.95% for dedicated capacity or an increased subscription commitment. This avoids exposure while giving Novatek a clear path to their target.
- Credit table: capped at 50% of monthly fees over any single incident month; incremental credits tiered to downtime buckets. See redline.

2) Incident response and escalation
- Acknowledgement vs. mitigation: clarify language that "acknowledgement" is automated triage and that "initial mitigation" is the first human action to contain root cause. Keep P1 mitigation within 60 minutes; P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes is acceptable.
- Require documented on-call escalation contacts and an escalation phone number in the Order Form.

3) Maintenance and exceptions
- Keep the two 4-hour planned windows per month, 72-hr notice for planned.
- Add carve-out for emergency security patches with an obligation to notify "as soon as practicable" plus a post-event report within 72 hours. We will limit this carve-out to critical security vulnerabilities that pose an immediate threat.

4) Measurement and exclusions
- Define clearly what counts toward downtime (service returns 200/requests vs 5xx errors) and tie measurement to the Redwood telemetry dashboard; allow 7-day rolling window for detecting sustained incidents.

I attached MSA_redlines_attorney_comments.pdf with inline comments and proposed tracked changes for the Order Form. Once you and Novatek align on availability approach, we'll finalize wording for the addendum.

Attachments: MSA_redlines_attorney_comments.pdf (PDF, 95 KB)

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

- I've created a short HubSpot deal task and added a 7-business-day review deadline: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4567890 (see activity).
- DocuSign: when everyone's agreed on the final tracked MSA and Order Form I'll coordinate execution. Draft DocuSign envelope placeholder here: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/example-docusign-link/DEAL-2028-0456

Proposed meeting: Mon 5/21 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to go through the redlines, confirm credit table, and agree on escalation points. If Novatek agrees to Premium Availability as a paid add-on, we can present pricing at that meeting.

Cheers,
